finalText:
Builds clean now, 0 errors.

Two real bugs were hiding under the deprecation noise, both from the bundler bump changing option shapes:

1. `src/core/options.js` still read `options.retries`, but the new bundler passes `retryCount`. That threw on `undefined.toFixed()`.
2. `src/net/retryPolicy.js` required `backoffEnabled` to be strictly `true` or `false`, but the new config loader leaves it `undefined` when unset. That threw too.

Fixed both, so retries resolve and backoff just checks for `true` instead of demanding a boolean. Build now finishes with 8 warnings, 0 errors, those remaining warnings are just the deprecation noise from the bump, nothing broken.
